title: Only 13 percent of companies see real returns from AI, Gartner survey finds
summary_raw: Only 13 percent of companies are getting real business value from their AI investments, according to a Gartner survey of 2,002 CIOs. title: Recursive shows first result of its AI-driven research process with Flint
summary_raw: The AI startup Recursive is unveiling Flint, its first language model, a 40-billion-parameter MoE for local coding developed by former DeepMind researchers. It was created in four months using the company's in-house AI system, "Eureka Machine," which independently tests and optimizes architectures. Recursive has yet to prove whether this approach will actually lead to self-improving AI.
